summary: Congressional interference in D.C. governance continues to be a focal point for statehood advocates, with coverage addressing recent attacks on local authority and a federal takeover situation, while also highlighting renewed congressional support for statehood efforts. The headlines also reflect ongoing concerns about federal control over D.C.'s National Guard and security decisions. Without statehood, Congress can override any law the District passes and can impose policies on D.C. without local consent.
